label: Cursor reveal
desc: A circular mask follows the pointer and uncovers a second layer under the first; arrow keys and taps move it too.
use: Before/after or day/night image sections on landing pages, product theme previews.

label: Peel reveal
desc: A sticker corner peels back toward the pointer's nearest corner to reveal content underneath; a corner button toggles it.
use: Promo codes, coupons, spoiler or reward reveals in cards on landing and dashboard pages.

label: Caption reveal
desc: Pictures whose caption slides or wipes in on hover or focus, and stays visible on touch screens.
use: Gallery, destinations, team or portfolio grids on landing pages.

label: Layer explorer
desc: An illustration of stacked layers that separate in 3D (exploded view) on hover, focus or tap, with a legend that highlights each layer.
use: Explaining product anatomy or architecture layers on landing and docs pages.

label: Jelly text
desc: Headline letters wobble like jelly as the pointer passes over them, each letter a spring; tap or Enter sends a wave.
use: Playful hero headlines and 404 or empty-state titles.

label: Holographic card
desc: A card with a rainbow foil sheen and glare that follow the pointer, plus a 3D tilt; safe in light mode, with arrow-key and idle-sweep fallbacks.
use: Membership, plan or achievement cards on dashboards and landing pages.

label: Parallax card
desc: A layered landscape whose layers shift by depth with the pointer; arrow keys nudge it and touch screens get a slow drift.
use: Feature cards, destination teasers and hero tiles on landing pages.

label: Orbiting accents
desc: Small shapes orbit a badge on two rings and smoothly speed up on hover, focus or tap.
use: Highlighting a pro/plan badge, integration hub or status badge on landing and dashboard pages.
